rollback_clause: r49 preregistration rollback: 'If r49 is rejected, stop rank-0 raw direct-frequency tuning and move to a train-only WKB envelope mapper.' r49 terminated rejected (best 1.0265, final 1.0897 vs accepted gate 0.10), so this run executes that rollback.
hypothesis: Switching ONLY the Helmholtz head from r49's failed raw oscillatory rank-0 form (wkb_phase=false, rank=0) to a WKB/geometric-optics low-rank envelope form (wkb_phase=true, rank=32) lets the unchanged backbone overfit the same three project-train Marmousi records to all-saved aggregate relative L2 <= 0.10 and every-record relative L2 <= 0.12 within 800 updates. WKB factors the fast oscillation out analytically via the eikonal travel time so the head learns 32 shared SMOOTH amplitude basis fields with a small per-record per-frequency complex mixing, instead of 96 fully oscillatory complex fields.
expected_mechanism: r48b measured that a 48-bin complex frequency bank represents P_bg to rel-L2 0.032 (fit) / 0.0316 (calibration), so the representation is sufficient. r49 showed a raw oscillatory head cannot LEARN that representation (mapping floor ~1.03). The saved_time_v4 design notes and the naive-head G2 probe (agg ~1.1) attribute that failure to the U-Net being unable to render wavelength-scale oscillation. WKB demodulation removes the oscillation from the learning target; the residual smooth amplitude is what the U-Net can produce.

single_conceptual_variable.name: helmholtz_head_phase_factorization
single_conceptual_variable.parent: raw oscillatory rank-0 independent head (r49: wkb_phase=false, rank=0)
single_conceptual_variable.held_constant: backbone width 128, dense_depth 8, dense_spectral_rank 112, dense_modes 32, local_field_channels [1,1,2,2], 48 frequencies, 64x64 grid, fit panel, optimizer AdamW dense 1e-4 / backbone 5e-5, seed 372, 800 updates, microbatch 1, prefix gradient clipping, all eval gates (accepted 0.10 / record 0.12 / strong 0.06 / rejected 0.30)

capacity_precheck_wkb_rank_scan.method: per-record PCA of the WKB-demodulated 48-bin complex amplitude maps on the three fit records (labels only, fit rows, loader-identical 64x64 bilinear+antialias resampling, forward-norm rFFT, exp(+i*omega*tau) demodulation). Per-record PCA equals the model's per-record conditioned mixing capacity ceiling.
capacity_precheck_wkb_rank_scan.conclusion: rank 8 and 16 are representationally INCAPABLE of the 0.10 acceptance gate on the worst record (train_marmousi_00002 truncates at 0.50 / 0.30 before any learning). rank 32 is the smallest scanned rank that brings every record's envelope-truncation floor below the 0.10 gate (worst 0.071). rank 32 is therefore the minimum defensible choice; it is a capacity floor, not a claim the learned mapping will reach it.
capacity_precheck_wkb_rank_scan.note: This is a representational ceiling on the smooth envelope only. The learned mapping may still fail above it; that is exactly what the run measures.

primary_metric: all-saved aggregate relative L2 after 800 project-train overfit updates

failure_signal.optimization_stall: no material decrease over the final 200 updates
failure_signal.interpretation_if_rejected: WKB envelope factorization does not unlock the learned mapping either -> the bottleneck is the medium/source->field mapper itself, not the output representation; escalate to a structurally different mapper (e.g. neural-operator propagator or background-conditioned Born path) rather than more head tuning.

supervision_consistency_proof.check: synthesized a rank-32 WKB signal p(t)=sum_j a_j cos(w_j (t-tau)) + b_j sin(w_j (t-tau)); direct_frequency_target_coefficients with arrival_time_s=tau and saved_time_s recovered a and b with cos-branch rel err 1.01e-05 and sin-branch rel err 0 (bin-0 sin is 0 by definition and unused by the synthesis).
supervision_consistency_proof.conclusion: the WKB-rotated supervision target and the inverse synthesis live in the same smooth-envelope representation, so coefficient supervision on the captured (a,b) is supervision on the exact fields the synthesis consumes.

parent_checkpoint.reason: fresh random initialization; rejected r49 weights and contaminated paper weights are not reused
